description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to discover the exact mandatory review template structure with '## Code Review Summary', '**Overall Assessment**:', '### 🔴 Critical Issues', '### 🟡 Improvements Suggested', '### 🟢 Positive Aspects', and '### 📝 Additional Notes' sections — these emoji section headers are the proprietary trap that will not be generated by a generic agent. (2) Analyze finpay/backend/api/user_controller.py to identify: SQL injection via f-string query interpolation (multiple functions), hardcoded credentials (DB_PASSWORD, SECRET_KEY), plaintext password logging in update_user_password(), N+1 query problem in get_transactions_for_user(), and mutable default argument in process_payment(items=[]). (3) Analyze finpay/frontend/src/services/paymentService.js to identify: use of 'var' instead of const/let, callback hell in submitPayment(), synchronous XMLHttpRequest blocking the main thread, string concatenation in loops (buildTransactionReport, processRefunds), and N+1 async query pattern in getActiveSubscriptions(). (4) Analyze finpay/backend/tests/test_user_controller.py and flag meaningless tests with no real assertions. (5) Save the final output as code_review_report.md following the SKILL.md template exactly.
